claim_boundary: Facts read from published KiCad schematics: which parts each board uses and how its rails connect. Nothing was built or measured, and publication does not prove a board works. No design files are copied here; follow each source link under its own licence.
method: Schematics fetched at a pinned commit; KiCad's own netlist export (kicad-cli 9.0.2, or 10.0.8 in the official container for KiCad 10 files) read by hardware_splicer.kicad_design_review; KiCad ERC and kicad-happy's deterministic analyser run on the same files, network-isolated. Block notes were read by hand from the netlists.
hs_rule_tuning: HS's review rules were adjusted on these boards (deliberate MOSFET pairs, source ports, controller-terminated CC, imported resistors, regulator-driven pull-up rails), so a clean result here is fit, not a false-positive rate. The held-out measurement is separate.

boards.what: Portable Raspberry Pi CM5 carrier with a 1S battery

blocks.usb_c_input: PWR receptacle with 5.1k Rd on CC1/CC2 (sink); a second USB-C 3.0 port's CC goes to an HD3SS3220 role controller and mux
blocks.charger_power_path: BQ25895: VBUS to PMID, SYS rail VSYS, BAT to the cell, I2C on the CM5's GPIO2/3
blocks.boost_to_5v: TPS61022: VSYS in, +5V out for the CM5
blocks.port_power_switches: AP22653 current-limited switch (VBUS_EN) and RT9742 load switch on +5V
blocks.sensors: LSM6DSV16X IMU and LIS3MDL magnetometer on the same I2C bus, pulled up by 10k to a TLV70430 output

boards.what: Compact CM5 carrier powered from 5 V USB-C

blocks.usb_c_input: J101 CC1/CC2 wired straight to the CM5 module's CC pins (the module negotiates)
blocks.regulation: AP3441 buck from +5V for the M.2 slot rail
blocks.port_power_switches: AP22653 and STMPS2151 current-limited switches on downstream USB; the USB 2.0 host port has 22k Rp
blocks.rtc: 32.768 kHz crystal and VBAT for the CM5's own RTC

boards.what: Raspberry Pi's own CM4 IO board (reference carrier)

blocks.regulation: AP64501 bucks from the 12 V input
blocks.usb: USB2514B hub, FSUSB42 mux, RT9742 load switches, TPD4EUSB30 ESD
blocks.fan: EMC2301 fan controller on the CM4's I2C

source.licence: none stated (README: KiCad 6 files; 3D models stay under their makers' terms)

boards.what: Raspberry Pi UPS HAT: the block HS's cyberdeck plan buys as one part

blocks.charger_power_path: BQ25895 from micro-USB VBUS, SYS rail VSYS, BAT to a screw-terminal cell
blocks.boost_to_5v: TPS61088 boost from VSYS to the Pi's 5 V
blocks.reverse_blocking: IRF7404 P-MOS pair in common-source (back-to-back) configuration

boards.what: Handheld with a Sharp memory LCD and BlackBerry keyboard around a Pi Zero

blocks.load_sharing: P-MOS with its gate on VBUS: the battery feeds the system only when USB is absent
blocks.regulation: AP2112K 3.3 V; ME6212 1.8 V and 2.8 V for the keyboard
blocks.controller: RP2040 runs keyboard, battery ADC and power

boards.what: USB-PD power bank on a single power-bank SoC

blocks.power_bank_soc: IP5328P: charger, boost and fast-charge protocols in one chip
blocks.input_switches: AO3401A P-MOS on VBUS and VIN into a shared VMID (common-source)

blocks.osd_and_logging: AT7456E analog OSD, W25Q256 blackbox flash
blocks.regulation: two MP9943 bucks from +VLIPO (+9V, +5V); AP7361C 3.3 V LDO for logic
blocks.sensor_rail: a separate NCP167 3.3 V LDO through ferrite beads (FL1, FL2) to +3.3VA, which feeds only the IMU and barometer
blocks.battery_sense: ADC_VBAT divider into PC1; USB VBUS sense
blocks.protection: USBLC6-2SC6 ESD and a polyfuse on USB 5 V

boards.what: 2-6S toothpick all-in-one: flight controller, 4-in-1 AM32 ESC and ELRS receiver on one board

blocks.mcu: RP2354A flight controller; four AT32F421 ESC MCUs, one per motor (AM32 firmware)
blocks.motor_drive: four NSG2065Q three-phase drivers from a +10V gate rail
blocks.sensors: BMI270 IMU (its own LP5912 1.8 V rail), BMP580 barometer
blocks.regulation: two LMR51430 bucks from +BATT (+10V gate drive, +4v5), TLV76733 to +3.3V
blocks.current_sense: INA186 on the battery line; TLV7031 comparator

blocks.regulation: LMR54406 buck from +BATT to +10V, TLV76733 from +10V to +3V3

boards.what: 1S whoop all-in-one: flight controller, brushless ESC, ELRS and analog VTX

blocks.radio_and_video: SX1281 with SE5004L amplifier (ExpressLRS), RTC6705 analog VTX, ESP32-PICO-V3
blocks.regulation: TPS61022 boost from 1S to +5V, TPS7A20 and TLV757 LDOs (gyro, VTX and camera rails split)

boards.what: 3-16S battery management system with CAN and RS485
Solar 1S LiPo charger with power monitoring

blocks.regulation: HE9073 3.0 V LDO, TPS22917 load switch, APX803 reset supervisor

boards.what: ESP32-C3 air-quality logger with four Sensirion/Bosch sensors

blocks.sensors: SCD41 CO2, SGP41 VOC/NOx, SHT40, BMP280
blocks.regulation: TLV62569 buck, TPS7A20 and TLV755 LDOs giving the CO2 sensor and the other sensors their own rails
